# Nested completion input and a formal result

The provider's sole Object-bounded method formal occurs in a nested completion
input and in its direct result. Its callback has two input slots and an Object
result slot. The original checked exception declaration remains explicit.

Frozen observers compare ordinary and class-initializer callers, argument and
initialization order, exact callback/completion/reference identities, direct
returns, delivered values, suspension without delivery, partial completion,
checked and unchecked failures, nulls and failed initialization caching. The
provider decides every result and callback action. No source adapter invokes or
converts the callback. Every generated Java source compiles at release 8; all
original definitions, metadata and Exceptions are compared in source and SDK
profiles. Compiler originals, D8 input and frozen callers stay immutable.
